text:
alex: Quick sync — can we tighten up the oncall handoff & triage attendance rules? Running into ambiguity on who joins P1 triage calls and when.

alex: Proposal:
- Weekdays handoff at 17:30 UTC (20m).
- Immediate P1 triage call if incident is open >30m or severity escalates.
- Required on P1 calls: current oncall, primary SRE, service owner (if on rotation), and product PM if incident impacts customer-facing flows.
- Weekly shadow pairing: two engineers buddy up for handoffs one week at a time.

alex: Sample calendar title for invites: `Oncall Handoff / Triage (20m)`

morgan: +1 to standardizing time, but 17:30UTC is rough for APAC. Can we add an optional 8:30 JST shadow handoff for folks in APAC? :thinking_face:

rachel: For the "service owner" bit — can we call it "service oncall" so responsibility is clear. Also prefer PM only when customer-facing impact is confirmed, otherwise it's noise. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Quick Q — does PD auto-dial the entire rotation or just pages oncall? If PD can auto-bridge P1 after 2 pages, we should mention that so people expect the call.

oncall-bot: Reminder: existing policy auto-bridges to the triage bridge for P1 incidents after 2 missed escalations (10m). See docs: https://internal.redwood/ops/oncall/policies

oncall-bot: Also: Calendar template under Shared Calendars > Oncall Templates.

emily: I like the weekly shadow pairing. Volunteers can sign up in the #eng-oncall-thread pinned note. Suggest pairing length = 7 days to avoid churn.

michael: Friday edge-case: if a handoff falls on Friday close-of-day with an active P1, infra lead should get looped (we escalate cross-team then). Propose infra oncall weekend fallback.

alex: Good call, michael — add infra lead as optional required on Friday handoffs when P1 open.

alex: Action items:
- update oncall doc with new cadence & required attendees (I'll PR).
- add APAC optional mini-handoff for JST folks (morgan to draft).
- clarify PD auto-bridge behavior in doc (sanjay to confirm with ops).
- set up signup sheet for weekly shadow pairing (emily to create).

rachel: I'll update the service owner phrasing in the doc and add a short flowchart for escalation.

morgan: I'll draft the APAC handoff invite and post here for review tomorrow.

sanjay: I'll ping ops and confirm auto-bridge times, will report back here.

emily: I'll create the signup doc and add owners column so rotations are explicit.

alex: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD UTC tomorrow I'll land the PR and update the calendar templates. :rocket:
